# EAP (Enterprise Architecture Practice) Assessments

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Strategy](../../README.md) • [Assessments](../README.md)**

---

> Assessments focused on evaluating the maturity, effectiveness, and capabilities of the Enterprise Architecture practice itself. These assessments measure the EA function's organizational impact, process maturity, governance effectiveness, and strategic alignment.

---
page_texts.3:
[strategy/assessments/eap/README.md#-maturity-assessmentsmaturityreadmemd]

### 🎯 [Maturity Assessments](./maturity/README.md)

Comprehensive evaluations of EA practice maturity using industry-standard frameworks like CMMI, TOGAF, and custom maturity models.

**Focus Areas:**

- EA governance and decision-making processes
- Architectural methodology and standards adoption
- Stakeholder engagement and communication effectiveness
- Architecture artifact quality and completeness
- Team capabilities and skill development
- Tool and platform utilization

[strategy/assessments/eap/README.md#maturity-levels]

### Maturity Levels

EAP assessments use a **5-level maturity framework** based on CMMI principles:

| Level | Name                       | Description                                                   |
| ----- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **1** | **Initial**                | Ad-hoc, reactive approach with inconsistent processes         |
| **2** | **Managed**                | Basic project-level discipline with some repeatable processes |
| **3** | **Defined**                | Organization-wide standards with consistent practices         |
| **4** | **Quantitatively Managed** | Measured and predictive processes with performance management |
| **5** | **Optimizing**             | Continuous improvement with innovation-driven enhancement     |

### For EA Leadership

- **Strategic Planning** - Use assessment results to guide EA roadmap and investment decisions
- **Performance Management** - Track EA practice improvement over time
- **Resource Allocation** - Prioritize capability development based on assessment gaps
- **Stakeholder Communication** - Demonstrate EA value and progress to leadership
page_texts.13:
[strategy/assessments/eap/README.md#for-ea-team-members]

### For EA Team Members

- **Professional Development** - Identify personal and team skill development opportunities
- **Process Improvement** - Contribute to methodology and practice enhancements
- **Best Practice Sharing** - Learn from assessment findings and recommendations
- **Quality Assurance** - Ensure consistent application of EA standards and practices

### Regular Assessment Cycles

- **Annual Comprehensive Review** - Full EA practice maturity assessment
- **Quarterly Progress Reviews** - Focused assessments on improvement initiatives
- **Project-Based Assessments** - EA effectiveness evaluation for major initiatives
- **Ad-hoc Reviews** - Targeted assessments based on organizational needs
page_texts.16:
[strategy/assessments/eap/README.md#assessment-governance]

### Assessment Governance

- **Peer Review Process** - Internal validation of assessment results
- **Stakeholder Validation** - Business and IT leadership review and input
- **Action Planning** - Development of improvement roadmaps based on findings
- **Progress Tracking** - Regular monitoring of improvement initiative progress
